title: Magneto-Inertial Fusion (MagLIF) Trade Study: Path to a 0.1 Hz Repetition-Rate Reactor

claims: A recirculating liquid-metal liner with integrated tritium extraction for magneto-inertial fusion reactors.
A segmented magnetically-insulated transmission line with argon-flush dielectric recovery for rep-rated pulsed-power fusion drivers.
A closed-loop laser pre-heat optical path with self-cleaning gas-jet windows for high-repetition-rate inertial-confinement fusion systems.

extra.abstract: Trade study of the MagLIF parameter space identifying a credible 0.1 Hz reactor concept with three patentable sub-systems.
